text: Relay DSH Workbench Plugin 是面向 DSH Web 的工作台外壳，为其他插件提供可注册的右侧与底部视图区域。它接管 Web 根布局，注册 sidebar、conversation、details 和 shell.overlay 等槽位，并通过公开的 workbench API 管理扩展视图。工作台支持切换及关闭面板、选择视图、拖动调整列宽，并把当前主题投影到页面。适合开发 DSH Web 面板插件并需要复用通用布局的开发者；单独安装不会显示额外功能，需由其他插件注册视图。

Relay DSH Workbench Plugin adds a shared panel shell to DSH Web. Other plugins register side and bottom views through its API; users can switch, open, close, and resize panels. It applies the active DSH theme for DSH view plugins. By itself, it adds no visible view.

Relay DSH Workbench Plugin 的功能「侧栏与底部扩展视图」：其他插件可注册 side 或 bottom 视图，工作台展示并支持切换；注销函数可移除已注册视图。
Relay DSH Workbench Plugin 的功能「可调节工作区布局」：DSH Web 根布局提供侧栏、会话、详情和扩展面板区域，用户可拖动分隔线调整列宽并开关面板；窄视口会自动折叠侧栏。
Relay DSH Workbench Plugin 的功能「同步页面主题」：插件读取 DSH 当前主题并监听主题变更，将颜色方案、主题 token 和浏览器主题色应用到页面，清理时撤销自己写入的样式。

when you are developing or testing another Workbench view plugin. Normal users
usually install Workbench together with a feature plugin such as Files or
Terminal.

The screenshot was captured from official DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` with Workbench and
Files installed. Workbench alone keeps the default DSH layout until a feature
plugin registers a view.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · Do I Need This Plugin?：Install it manually when using GitHub development builds of
`relay-dsh-plugin-files` or `relay-dsh-plugin-terminal`. DSH's pnpm profile
blocks GitHub packages as transitive dependencies, so development installs list
Workbench and the feature plugin in the same command.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · 1. Install：Stop a running DSH Web process before changing Profile plugins.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · GitHub development build：Use this when you want the latest development build:

```bash
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add github:yangbobo2021/relay-dsh-plugin-workbench#main
```

For a reproducible install, replace `#main` with a tag or full commit SHA.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · npm release：Install the published package with:

```bash
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add relay-dsh-plugin-workbench@latest
```

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · 2. Start or restart DSH Web：```bash
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 web
```

If you already have a `dsh` command installed, `dsh web` is equivalent. Restart
DSH Web after installing, updating, or removing plugins.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · 3. Confirm behavior：Workbench alone keeps the normal DSH conversation layout. It only becomes visible
when another plugin registers a side or bottom view. For an end-user visible test,
install the Files or Terminal plugin instead.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · What It Provides：- A generic right-side panel region
- A generic bottom panel region
- The public `ctx.workbench` registry for view plugins
- Public contracts at `relay-dsh-plugin-workbench/contracts`
- Idempotent activation, so multiple feature plugins can safely bring Workbench
  into the same DSH Profile

Feature plugins should use `ctx.workbench`, keyed DSH slots, and the public
contracts entry. They should not import Workbench source files.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · Plugin Boundary and Relay：This repository is maintained as part of
[Relay](https://github.com/yangbobo2021/Relay), an open-source project for
long-running agent work, external-event delivery, reusable DSH workbench views,
and multiple conversation backends.

Workbench is intentionally small. It owns only the common panel shell; Files,
Terminal, Codex, Claude, and Events remain separate optional plugins.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · Update, Inspect, or Remove：Stop DSH Web before changing plugins, then restart it afterward.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web why relay-dsh-plugin-workbench
dsh plugin --profile web update relay-dsh-plugin-workbench
dsh plugin --profile web remove relay-dsh-plugin-workbench
```

For GitHub installs, `pnpm` records the package source inside the DSH Profile.
Run `dsh plugin --profile web why relay-dsh-plugin-workbench` to inspect it.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · Nothing changed after installing Workbench：That is expected when Workbench is installed by itself. It is a host shell for
other plugins. Install Files or Terminal to see a new panel.

relay-dsh-plugin-workbench README · DSH fails to start after a plugin change：Restart DSH Web and inspect the plugin source:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web why relay-dsh-plugin-workbench
```

If the package came from GitHub `main`, try pinning a known commit SHA.
